description_en: Modifies the global IP whitelist template associated with an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库 MongoDB 版的全局IP白名单模板
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-global-security-ip-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name dps --global-security-group-id g-fwjk62egbsrp4sftxmmr --gip-list 27.16.214.10,111.60.117.181 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyGlobalSecurityIPGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the IP whitelist template
parameters.name: global_ig_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IP whitelist template
parameters.name: global_security_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). You can create up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks for all IP address whitelists
parameters.help_zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

多个IP地址需要用英文逗号隔开，所有IP白名单累积支持添加1000个IP地址或地址段
parameters.name: gip_list
